title: Russian ballistic missiles slam Kyiv, damage Northern Bridge, injure 6 people
summary: Among the five injured in the city of Kyiv is a 14-year-old girl, and two people have been hospitalized, Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko said.

title: Musk reposts tweet calling Starlink service for Ukraine 'mistake'
summary: "In hindsight, it was a mistake for SpaceX to send (Ukraine) thousands of free Starlink dishes and millions of dollars a month in free service at the beginning of the war," the post reads.

title: Ukraine strikes Oryol factory with Neptune missile, reportedly Saratov Oil Refinery in mass attack on Russian regions
summary: Ukraine struck various sites in the Russian regions of Oryol, Saratov, and Rostov, hitting an oil refinery among several targets overnight on Nov. 7, monitoring channels reported.

title: General Staff: Russia has lost 1,604,110 troops in Ukraine since Feb. 24, 2022
summary: The number includes 2,280 casualties that Russian forces suffered over the past day.
